prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: a chicken breast hitting a screaming-hot grill pan with a loud sizzle, dark grill marks forming. The camera slides to a pan where colorful vegetables — bell pepper strips, broccoli florets, red onion — are tossed in the air and caught, glistening with olive oil. Money shot: the sliced grilled chicken fanned over a warm bowl of sweet potato mash, fresh herbs falling onto it in slow motion, steam backlit gold. Final beat: the complete colorful plate on the table, generous and abundant, fork entering. Warm dramatic side light, deep shadows, macro on the grill crust, film grain. Dominant sound: the sear, then the vegetable toss. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Prato cheio, colorido, de verdade — porque cardápio de emagrecimento que passa fome dura três dias.

O Emagrecimento Consciente é a semana inteira montada pra quem quer perder peso sem dieta restritiva: comida que sustenta, porção que satisfaz.

Comenta LEVE que te mando o cardápio completo na DM 📩
